order_text: “I need a pizza with nothing on it.”
“I don't want a plain flatbread. It has to have red and green sauce. But the sauces can't mix together!”
clarification_text: “A half pesto and half tomato sauce flatbread!”

order_text: “I'm here for the wheat sauce, boss.”
“What's healthier than green sauce on wheat? Half cheese.”
clarification_text: “Pesto on wheat dough! Cheese on one side. I'm trying to be healthy.”

order_text: “I want a mushion pizza, brown dough. Cheese on the mush side, sauce on the onion side.”
clarification_text: “A half mushroom and cheese-half onion and sauce pizza on wheat dough, please.”

order_text: “I want to hand out a few slices of your pizza to spread some pizza joy. Gimme one pep and one cheese. 8 slices for both.”
clarification_text: “Two cheese pizzas, but put pepperoni on one of them. Cut them in half four times.” (Cut the pizzas four times each.)

order_text: “I'd like to get a pepperoni with half olives, please.”
“Did you know some ancient civilizations worshiped onions? The sphere shape and concentric rings can symbolize eternal youth.”
clarification_text: “Well I find it interesting. One onion pizza, please!”

order_text: “I want 18 sausages and 9 figs on a 6-slice pizza. Keep the figs on one side of the pizza.”
clarification_text: “There should be 18 sausages across all 6 slices of pie and 9 figs on half of the pie.”
“Two pizzas with duck! Fire it up twice!” (Run the pizza through the oven twice .)
